conditions./streams/*/packets/*/dts: reference = candidate + minimum; every other gating field direct

conditions.reference /format_duration_us: = max(start + duration) - min(start), with start = empty edit rounded to stream ticks, and max(start + duration) = movie header duration, to 1 microsecond

conditions./format_duration_us: candidate = movie header duration in microseconds
conditions.reference /format_duration_us: = max(start + reference duration) - min(start), start = empty edit rounded to stream ticks, to 1 microsecond; at least one stream covered by this entry

conditions./streams/*/properties/edits: supported shape: optional empty edit, one media edit at rate 1
